type Arg<F> = F extends (value: infer U) => void ? U : never;
const required: Arg<(value: string) => void> = undefined;
const optional: Arg<(value?: number) => void> = 'other';
function withDefault(value = 5) {}
const fallback: Arg<typeof withDefault> = 'other';
type FirstAndTail<F> = F extends (first: infer T, ...tail: infer U) => void ? [T, U] : never;
const rest: FirstAndTail<(...items: string[]) => void> = ['a', [1]];
